data.investment_objective: To generate long-term capital appreciation by creating a portfolio that is invested predominantly in Equity and Equity related securities of companies engaged in commodity and commodity related sectors. However there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation:
• Equity & Equity related instruments of companies engaged in commodity and commodity related sectors = 80% -100%
• Other equity and equity related securities = 0% -20%
• Debt, Units of debt Mutual Fund schemes and Money market instruments = 0% -20%
• Gold ETFs/ Silver ETFs/ other asset classes as may be permitted by SEBI from time to time (subject to applicable SEBI limits) = 0% -20%
data.exit_load:
1% of applicable Net Asset Value - If the amount sought to be redeemed or switch out is invested for a period of up to three months from the date of allotment
Nil - If the amount sought to be redeemed or switch out is invested for a period of more than three months from the date of allotment
